cards.title: Starship Flight 14 · first Starlink V3 deploy
cards.body: 26 Starlink V3 deployed (~161 mi alt); Musk: all 26 nominal / operating; SpaceX: expected to raise orbits and serve customers in a few weeks — first revenue-generating Starship mission framing. NASA Admin Jared Isaacman congratulated on X. Still ahead: orbital refueling demo + Ship RTLS/catch.
cards.extra: Musk: all 26 nominal / operating (per Jim Sep 29 recap). First revenue-generating Starship framing in journal.

cards.title: Last planned Falcon 9 Starlink from Florida
cards.body: SpaceX VP of Launch Kiko Dontchev: Tue Aug 25 SLC-40 flight was the last planned Falcon 9 Starlink from Florida; future East Coast Starlink on Starship; Vandenberg continues Falcon 9 Starlink.
cards.extra: Journal also notes ~260 Falcon 9 Starlink missions from Florida since May 23, 2019 (company statement coverage).

cards.title: Starlink 10-49 (Cape)
cards.body: Falcon 9 launched 29 Starlink satellites from SLC-40, Cape Canaveral, Tue Aug 25, 2026 at 5:33 a.m. ET (SpaceX mission page per Jim).
cards.extra: Booster B1067, 37th flight; landing A Shortfall of Gravitas. Official wording: “29 Starlink satellites” (v2-mini is tracker language).

cards.title: Starlink 15-22 (Vandenberg)
cards.body: Falcon 9 launched 27 Starlink satellites from SLC-4E, Vandenberg, Wed Aug 26, 2026 at 2:35 a.m. PT / 5:35 a.m. ET (SpaceX mission page per Jim).
cards.extra: Booster B1082, 24th flight. First Falcon 9 Starlink from Vandenberg after Florida Falcon Starlink pause statement.

cards.title: Next Falcon Starlink · Group 15-25 (journal carry)
cards.body: **No new Thu ops** beyond F14 LEO + 26 Starlink V3 deploy (Mon Sep 28). Wed/Thu capacity pieces (e.g. Tesla Oracle ~26 Tbps framing) are day-after analysis, not a new flight. Next classic Falcon Starlink: **Group 15-25 NET Sat Oct 10 ~16:00 UTC**, SLC-4E Vandenberg (~27 V2 Mini; booster B1082 ~25th flight per trackers).
cards.extra: Live NET/pad/status come from Launch Library 2 via Mission Control cache (see Launch cadence panel) — journal NET may be stale vs LL2.

cards.title: Starmind / Starlink plans (Space Safety page)
cards.body: Jim Oct 6: SpaceX Space Safety page plans “up to 100,000 Starlink” and “up to 1 million Starmind AI satellites.” FCC still reviewing Starmind application (Oct 7 carry: no new facts).
cards.extra: These are published plans / application framing — not in-orbit counts.

cards.title: V3 deploy video + LEO maneuver data push
cards.body: Jim Oct 6: Starlink posted first video of V3 sats deploying from Starship; also argued undisclosed maneuvers by other operators are the biggest LEO risk (~half of ~650 maneuvering sats encountered share data — per journal).
